text:
Ellen - Sales: Raj's POC keeps failing when streaming through their corporate forward proxy. Can Eng + DevEx assist?
Kai - DevEx: Which SDK/version and what error?
Raj - Customer: TS SDK v1.6.0. Stream starts then stalls ~10s; app logs show socket read timeout, proxy returns 502 or 504 intermittently.
Priya - Eng: Likely proxy idle/inspection. Are you sending chunked transfer?
Raj - Customer: Yes, chunked. They mandate HTTP_PROXY so we can't unset it.
Sam - Support: Workarounds: 1) heartbeat small chunks periodically, 2) switch to short polling (no stream), 3) route via a temporary dedicated endpoint to bypass corporate egress.
Kai - DevEx: Quick TS snippet to enable keepAlive and shorter client timeout:
```
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, keepAliveMsecs: 12000 });
await client.responses.stream(req, { fetchOptions: { agent, timeout: 20000 } });
```
Priya - Eng: Heartbeat was effective in our nginx sim at 3s intervals. If proxy buffers chunked bodies fully, heartbeat won't help and Dedicated POC is needed.
Ellen - Sales: Raj, would a short Dedicated trial be acceptable while infra evaluates proxy change?
Raj - Customer: Procurement prefers temporary dedicated endpoint. Please send instructions.
Sam - Support: Action items: Priya to publish heartbeat test notes; Kai to provide TS + Python snippets; Ellen to provision Dedicated POC quote and coords.
Raj - Customer: Thanks all, will await the runbook.
